item.title: Iranian Christian who came to US as an adopted orphan fears deportation would be a death sentence
item.description: An Iranian-born Christian woman who entered the United States as a young child says deportation proceedings against her could amount to a death sentence if she is forced to return to Iran. The case involves a decades old citizenship gap affecting some international adoptees who were raised in the U.S. yet never formally naturalized. #IranianChristian #USImmigration #ChristianPersecution #ReligiousFreedom #Deportation #DeathSentence #USCitizenship #Adoption

item.title: Adrian Davis, pastor who embezzled over $400K from church, gets 5 years in prison
item.description: Adrian Davis, a disgraced pastor from Huntsville, Alabama, who embezzled more than $400,000 from his church and splurged on cars and luxury items, has been sentenced to five years in prison. #AdrianDavis #Pastor #Embezzlement #Huntsville #Alabama

item.title: Kindergarten teacher who identified as ‘trans wolf,’ wore collar and tail, fired after parents raise alarm
item.description: A kindergarten substitute teacher who identified as a “trans wolf” and wore a collar and tail in class has been fired after parents raised concerns. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth confirmed the dismissal following complaints from military families. #NorthCarolina #Kindergarten #TransWolf #FortBragg

item.title: Canadian man fined $750K for saying only 2 sexes exist, refusing to kowtow to trans ideology
item.description: A former Canadian school board of trustees member who has been fined $750,000 over his public comments expressing opposition to the promotion of trans ideology in schools is appealing the decision. #Canada #transgender #genderconfusion #transindoctrination #children #education

item.title: Beloved Houston pastor shot dead by roommate during home invasion
item.description: Detectives with the Houston Police Department are investigating after Amor y Restauración (Love and Restoration) church lead pastor, Pedro Cantu, was fatally shot by his roommate during a break-in at his home on Saturday. #Houston #PedroCantu #ShotDead

item.title: Top 6 moments from Mike Huckabee's tense interview with Tucker Carlson: 'Frankly confusing'
item.description: Political commentator Tucker Carlson and U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee sat down for a nearly three-hour discussion that grew heated at times as the two wrangled over Christian Zionism, the rights of modern Israel and how Christians are treated in the Holy Land. #TuckerCarlson #MikeHuckabee #Israel

item.title: Sight & Sound explores biblical liberty in ‘The Great Awakening’
item.description: As America approaches its 250th anniversary, the word “liberty” is resurfacing in cultural debates, but for Sight & Sound CEO Joshua Enck, the word carries a deeper meaning, serving as the inspiration for the ministry’s new film, “The Great Awakening.” #SightSound #TheGreatAwakening #movie #liberty #JoshuaEnck

item.title: Montgomery County must pay $1.5M to religious parents after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: A federal judge ordered Maryland's largest school district to pay $1.5 million to parents who sued the school system after it took away parental notice and opt-outs for LGBT-themed storybooks, some of which promoted gender transitioning and pride parades to children as young as 4. #MontgomeryCounty #parentalnotification #SupremeCourt #LGBT #religiousfreedom

item.title: Kash Patel defends beer-guzzling party with Olympic hockey team amid backlash: 'Yes, I love America'
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel defended himself against online backlash to footage showing him guzzling beer and celebrating with the U.S. men's hockey team in their locker room Sunday, following their last-minute gold medal victory against Canada at the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics. #KashPatel #FBI #Olympics #sports

item.title: ‘Attack on Christians’: Human rights group responds to Turkey’s defense of missionary expulsions
item.description: Rights group ADF International has condemned Turkey’s rejection of a European Parliament resolution on the expulsion of foreign Christians, with critics calling the policy an “attack on Christians” and urging authorities to respect due process and religious freedom. #ADFInternational #Turkey #EuropeanParliamentResolution #ExpulsionofForeignChristians #Missionaries #AttackonChristians #ReligiousFreedom
